We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants. Candidates who require accommodation during the recruitment process or at work are encouraged to contact **HR@LEO-PHARMA.COM** to discuss their needs. **Beyond the skin** Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. momentum, communication, and making sure nothing the client is waiting on quietly stalls * Build the case for continued engagement and conversion to recurring work from the beginning of every engagement, not in the last two weeks * Understand each client's business well enough to see what they should be doing next and say so before they ask **Retention and Conversion** * Keeping the account is the job; retention is the primary metric this role is measured against * On fixed-term engagements, conversion to a recurring retainer is designed in from kickoff * Manage two types of accounts simultaneously: fixed-term research engagements that must convert to recurring work, and monthly retainer clients that must keep proving their value against the invoice **Cadence and Visible Progress** * Run a weekly client call, weekly status update, and live tracker that is always current * Deliver a first progress update within the first few days of an engagement and get real work in front of the client by the end of week one * A client who does not know where things stand will assume the worst; your job is to make sure that never happens **Delivery Team Coordination** * Each account runs as a small pod: a senior strategist owns technical strategy, a writer owns production, and you own everything in between * Chase down inputs the strategist needs including analytics access, source systems, and SME time before the client notices they are missing * Hold the delivery team accountable to timelines, quality standards, and client expectations * Nothing reaches a client without your review; you are the last read before work goes out, and you are expected to find the buried point, kill the generic opener, and flag any claim with no number behind it **Reporting and Narrative** * Own what the numbers mean for each specific client and how they connect back to revenue * The strategist owns the measurement framework; you own the story it tells, and that story stays current all year, not just near renewal * Translate technical strategy and delivery into business language that resonates with a marketing exec **Risk and Escalation** * Surface blockers and timeline risk the day you see them, not at the next scheduled check-in * Deliver bad news directly, challenge a client's plan when warranted, and operate as an advisor rather than a vendor **What You Bring** * Proven end-to-end client relationship ownership with a track record previous clients can speak to by name and outcome * Experience running multi-workstream engagements with a cross-functional delivery team, and a clear record of being the one who kept the timeline honest * Ability to hold a room with senior executives without a technical co-pilot; comfortable delivering bad news, challenging a client's plan, and being treated as an advisor rather than a vendor * A specific account growth story: the largest account grown, from what number to what number, and the result that earned each step up * A client recovery story: a client who was slipping, the first signal, and what happened in the 48 hours after that signal was spotted * Enough SEO and AI search optimization knowledge to hold a credible conversation with a marketing exec and translate technical strategy into business language without losing the thread * Operationally relentless: same-day recaps, live trackers, no dropped threads, and a standard the team can rely on without checking * Willingness to push back when something is wrong, including pushing back on leadership when the strategy needs to be challenged **Nice to Have** * Experience building the process rather than only running it: a cadence structure, a handoff protocol, or a quarterly review motion that exists because of this person * Experience at an agency or professional services firm serving B2B accounts * Experience working inside AI tooling day to day with a clear view on which client touchpoints should stay human * Experience navigating a major platform or channel shift where the inherited playbook stopped working **How to Apply** Please include: * Your **updated resume** * A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your senior account management experience, and walking through a client you saved — the first signal they were slipping and what you did in the 48 hours after you saw it **Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.** If you are a senior account manager who has owned relationships end to end, kept cross-functional delivery teams accountable, and can be the person a client credits when they renew, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work. **Application Process Overview** Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients: 1. **Initial Application** - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions 2. **Video Introduction** - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience 3. **Role-Specific Assessment** - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable) 4. **Recruitment Interview** - Initial screening with our talent team 5. **Executive Interview** - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment 6. **Client Interview** - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting 7. **Background & Reference Check** - Professional reference verification 8. **Job Offer** - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

description: **Company Description** Medicine moves forward here. So will you. Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting. We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. description: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our growing brands at saas.group. You own retention and churn for a defined book of enterprise and mid-market accounts, and you're measured on how well that book retains. You use data to spot risk early, reach out before problems surface, and show customers the business value Prerender delivers. You'll also bring what you learn from customers back to our Product, Support and Marketing teams so we keep getting better. If you like building trusted relationships, working from data, and making technical topics simple, you'll thrive here. **Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:** * Build trusted relationships with assigned customers, understand their challenges and how Prerender can help * Start acting as an advisor on machine/AI visibility as Prerender repositions itself out of the pure SEO/rendering space. * After about a year, you should have measurably helped retain customers, understood early warning signals, and used the team's diagnostic/signal tooling to proactively reach out before issues escalate. **Your responsibilities** ------------------------- * **Own retention for your account book:** Take ownership of the retention and churn metrics (e.g. gross revenue retention and logo churn) for a defined book of accounts. Track them, report on them, and drive the actions that move them. * **Drive proactive retention:** Use usage data, health scores and risk signals to spot churn risk early, and run structured retention playbooks instead of waiting for tickets. * **Turn technical results into business value:** Explain Prerender's impact in terms your customers care about: indexing, organic traffic, AI-search visibility and revenue. * **Build lasting trust:** Hold regular check-ins and business reviews that keep customers seeing, and getting, value from Prerender. * **Be the voice of the customer:** Bring feedback, churn reasons and feature gaps back to Product, Support and Marketing in a structured way. * **Partner across teams:** Work closely with Account Managers, Support and Engineering so every customer gets a joined-up experience. **How We Work** --------------- At Prerender, Customer Success is proactive, data-informed and focused on outcomes. We don't wait for customers to come to us. * **Think in outcomes:** Success means the customer reached their goals, not just that a ticket was closed. * **Build shared context:** You make sure teams understand what customers need and why. * **Scale what works:** You help turn good one-off actions into repeatable playbooks. * **High trust, high ownership:** You're trusted to run your book your way. **A Typical Day Might Involve** ------------------------------- * Reviewing account health dashboards and picking out who needs attention this week * Reaching out to a customer whose usage has dropped before it turns into churn risk * Running a business review that shows a customer the SEO and AI-search impact of rendering * Helping a customer's developer understand a setup or caching question, and escalating to Engineering with clear context when needed * Briefing an Account Manager on account health and value delivered ahead of a renewal * Sharing customer feedback and trends with Product * Refining a retention playbook based on what you've learned **What You bring to the table** ------------------------------- * **Proven experience:** 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company in marketing, advertising, SEO or martech * **Retention mindset:** A track record of owning retention or churn targets for a book of accounts, and of reducing churn and keeping customers engaged * **Data-driven, AI-fluent approach:** Comfortable working with usage data, health scores and CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot), and using AI assistants connected to your tools and data to make decisions and automate routine work * **Business translator:** You can turn technical details into clear business value for non-technical and technical stakeholders alike * **Strong communicator:** Clear and confident in writing and on calls, in fluent English * **Structured and proactive:** You plan your work, follow through, and don't wait to be told * **Trusted advisor:** Warm, patient and a good listener who cares about customer outcomes. Customers enjoy working with you, and you're confident starting conversations and leading calls. * **Bonus: Technical product fluency.** It helps if you're tech-savvy and familiar with SEO, JavaScript websites, web crawlers, caching or web performance. We're happy to invest in training you on our product, so curiosity and willingness to learn matter more than specific technical expertise. **What's in it for You** ------------------------ * **Ultimate flexibility:** We're 100% remote. **5+ years of commercial PHP** (7.4+/8) at scale - clean, testable, maintainable code - **Production React** experience (TypeScript preferred) - **Strong PostgreSQL** - schema design, performant queries, migrations, execution plans - architecture, code quality and delivery * **Establish the team’s ways of working** - delivery process, Definition of Ready/Done, code review standards and technical onboarding, aligned with SINGU engineering practices * **Act as the primary technical contact for the client** - requirement workshops, solution design, estimates, technical status updates and escalations (in English) * Translate client needs into specifications and tasks the team can deliver without surprises; own the **final technical specification** * Own sprint planning, estimation and prioritization, balancing committed scope with ad-hoc client requests in alignment with account managers * Make architectural decisions for customizations so they **don’t fragment the core product**; align with Platform/Core teams and the Chief Architect * Review code, mentor engineers, run technical onboarding for newcomers * Drive engineering improvements in the team: testability, local environments, automated tests, CI * Stay hands-on - You’ll report to the **Engineering Manager** and work closely with account managers, QA, the Head of Software Engineering and the CTPO. **Why This Role** * **A greenfield opportunity** - you shape the team’s architecture, engineering practices and technical standards from the ground up * **Strategic visibility** - you lead the technical partnership with one of SINGU’s most important enterprise clients * **Technically demanding work** - enterprise integrations, data, performance and security, far beyond standard CRUD * **A balanced role** - technical leadership, client engagement and hands-on engineering in one position If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day. Compensation Range: $24K - $27K

title: Tech & Marketing Operations Specialist
description: **Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?** At **Aleph**, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies. Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels. With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career. We're looking for a proactive, resourceful, and AI-forward **Tech & Marketing Operations Specialist** to manage our technology projects, keep our learning platforms running seamlessly, and power the marketing engine that brings students to them This role suits someone with a broad technical fluency who thrives on coordination, troubleshooting, and hands-on building. You don't need to be a professional developer, but you do need to be comfortable using tech tools to design, prototype, and ship real solutions. The position will be based at the Warsaw office with a hybrid work model. ### **What You’ll Do** **Platform & Systems Management** --------------------------------- * **Tech project management:** Manage technology-related projects end to end — defining requirements, building timelines, tracking progress, and identifying improvements that serve broader project goals. * **LMS management (WordPress & LearnDash):** Own the day-to-day health of our WordPress-based LMS and LearnDash plugin — user administration, course administration, email flows, bulk imports, new features, configuration, and troubleshooting. * **CRM & Marketing Automation (Salesforce & Salesforce Marketing Cloud):** Act as first point of contact for Salesforce and SFMC — build and test journeys, landing pages, and lead magnets; investigate and resolve issues the Operations team can't solve; escalate and follow up when needed. * **System integration:** Serve as the architect making sure LMS, CRM, Marketing Cloud, and Power BI talk to each other correctly — designing and implementing the technical architecture for data flows between platforms, including low-code integrations. * **Data integrity & reporting:** Review data integrity across LearnDash, Salesforce, and Power BI; execute queries and build reports/extracts for non-technical stakeholders; handle large-scale data reviews (including million-row datasets) when needed. * **Website support:** Provide general technical support for the website and coordinate with relevant resources to resolve issues. * **Compliance & security:** Help bring the LMS environment up to the organization's IT and security standards, acting as liaison between the Education team, developers/cloud providers, and Security/Legal/IT. **Marketing Operations & Growth** --------------------------------- * **Campaign execution:** Build, test, and launch email and lifecycle campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud — segmentation, audience building, A/B tests, send scheduling, and deliverability hygiene. * **Landing pages & lead capture:** Build and ship landing pages and forms based on designs provided by the internal design team; ensure correct lead routing into Salesforce, field mapping, deduplication, and follow-up automation. * **Tracking & attribution:** Own the measurement layer — GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels, UTM taxonomy and enforcement — so that every campaign, source, and channel is measurable end to end. * **Lifecycle & retention automation:** Design automated flows across the student lifecycle (onboarding, course progress nudges, re-engagement, certification, upsell) connecting LMS events to CRM and Marketing Cloud triggers. * **Martech stack & compliance:** Own the marketing technology stack and its integrations; keep consent management, cookie compliance, and data handling aligned with privacy requirements and company policy. * **AI for marketing:** Apply the same builder mindset to marketing — AI-assisted copy and creative variants, campaign localization at scale, automated performance summaries, and audience insight tooling. **Technical Bridge & Coordination** ----------------------------------- * **Stakeholder liaison:** Serve as a primary point of contact between internal stakeholders (especially the development team) and business operations, translating business needs into functional technical specifications. * **Specification writing & QA:** Write clear technical specs, replicate scenarios, and fully test in QA and production before rollout. * **Documentation:** Keep the operations manual and technical documentation current and useful for the team. * **Cross-functional project leadership:** Lead multi-month initiatives (e.g., new catalog builds, platform redesigns, global/language expansions, migrations) from scoping through to launch — defining KPIs, coordinating between design/development/vendors, and testing at every step. **AI Development & Innovation** ------------------------------- * **AI builder mindset:** Go beyond being “AI-savvy” — actively explore, prototype, and build AI-powered solutions that improve how the team works and how students learn (e.g., translation tools, automation of repetitive data tasks, AI-assisted reporting). * **Tool development:** Design and build practical AI tools and workflows (e.g., custom Gemini/Claude “gems”/assistants, scripts, or low-code automations) to solve real operational bottlenecks — not just use off-the-shelf AI features. * **Exploration & evaluation:** Stay current on emerging AI tools and platforms relevant to EdTech operations, and proactively propose where they could create value (efficiency, personalization, translation, content scaling, etc.). * **AI project ownership:** Take end-to-end ownership of AI-driven initiatives — from investigating alternatives and setting up integrations, to testing and rolling out to production (as previously done with AI-powered course translation tooling). * **Responsible use:** Use AI tools in a way that's compliant with company confidentiality and data-security standards, and only with company-approved systems. ### **What You Need For This Role** * You have a solid, broad understanding of technology and digital platforms, and you're comfortable getting hands-on rather than just directing others. * You have 5+ years of experience managing Education and Marketing tech projects. * You are genuinely curious about AI and see it as a tool to build with, not just a topic to discuss — you've built something with AI before (a workflow, an automation, an integration, a tool). * You bring project management skills with a track record of leading initiatives from scope to delivery. * You're a strong communicator who moves comfortably between technical and non-technical audiences. * You're a proactive problem-solver, able to identify needs and find the right solutions, people, and tools without waiting to be asked. * You understand marketing funnels and growth metrics (CPL, CAC, conversion rate, LTV) and can translate them into technical requirements. * Hands-on experience with marketing automation and campaign tooling (Salesforce Marketing Cloud strongly preferred) is highly valued. * Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking setups is a strong plus. * You are comfortable owning both the plumbing and the outcome — not just that the campaign sends, but that it performs. * Experience with WordPress and/or LMS platforms (ideally LearnDash) is a strong plus. * Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce/Salesforce Marketing Cloud preferred) and data/BI tools (Power BI) is highly valued. * You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple concurrent projects. * You're a self-starter, comfortable working independently. ### **What Will Make Us Really Love You** * You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience. * You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table. * You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions. * You have an eye for detail. * You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit. * You’re genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends. * You have the ability to engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way. ### **What You’ll Love About Us** * We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position * Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising * Be part of a company with a truly global footprint, working with leading brands, platforms, and publishers across 90+ markets. * We foster a dynamic environment where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged and celebrated. * Join a diverse, multicultural team that values and embraces different perspectives, experiences, and talents. * At Aleph, your work directly contributes to connecting brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we are committed to fair and open compensation practices. For this role, the minimum gross annual base salary is PLN 140,000. In addition to base salary, this role includes a variable component, paid annually. The final offer will reflect your experience, skills, and the scope of the role. **Why Join Us?** Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities. We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. title: Senior Specialist, Creative Strategy & Performance (Paid Marketing)
description: **Company Description** At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es **Why join us?** Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success. **Job Description** Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline. You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap. We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on! **How will you make an impact?** **Creative Strategy** * Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals * Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs * Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements **Asset Preparation & Coordination** * Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking * Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable * Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework **Creative Intelligence & Testing** * Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence * Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results * Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs **Tracking & Measurement** * Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately * Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines **Team Flexibility** * Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives. **What We're Looking For** * 4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus) * Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched * Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale * Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions * Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation * Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams * Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint * Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools * Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools * Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models **What to Expect from Our Hiring Process** We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): **Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. **TestGorilla –** (SHL numerical reasoning assessment). **Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. **Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings. **Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. **References & Offer!** **Why You’ll Love It Here** **Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: * Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. * Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. * Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. **Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. **Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. **A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. **Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. *Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. **What We Believe In** At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: **Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact. **Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes. **Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity. **Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust. **Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job. Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say! **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_** We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Organic Growth Lead
description: **TransferGo** is a growing fintech scale-up on a mission to champion financial freedom with care. We strive to provide tailored, more affordable financial services that make people's hard-earned money go further. We are looking for someone to own how TransferGo is discovered across search engines, AI-powered platforms and our website. This is broader than a traditional SEO role. You will lead technical and international SEO, content discoverability, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and our website growth roadmap. Your goal will be to turn search demand and emerging forms of AI discovery into measurable customer acquisition. You will own organic discovery across search engines, AI assistants and the website. Your primary contribution will be growing the share of new customers acquired through non-paid channels. This supports the Director's incremental activation goal and the three measures used to evaluate the Growth & Marketing function: monthly active customers, six-month customer value relative to acquisition cost, and the share of acquisition generated through non-paid channels. **Here's what you'll be doing as Organic Growth Lead:** **Search and organic growth** Set and deliver TransferGo's global organic search strategy. You will lead technical SEO across crawling, indexing, JavaScript rendering, site architecture, internal linking, structured data and Core Web Vitals. You will also lead international SEO across our priority countries, languages and send-and-receive routes, including localisation and hreflang at scale. You will build and manage a prioritised organic growth roadmap with Product, Engineering, Content and Marketing. You will identify opportunities based on customer needs, search demand and commercial priorities, protect organic performance during releases, migrations and structural changes, and strengthen our authority through digital PR, partnerships and link building. **AI visibility, AEO and GEO** Define how TransferGo appears across AI-powered discovery platforms, including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. You will improve how these platforms understand, represent and reference TransferGo. That includes developing content and structured-data approaches that increase our chances of being surfaced and cited, while strengthening our topical authority, brand entities and trust signals across the web. You will monitor AI visibility, brand mentions, citations, accuracy and competitive presence, and work with Brand, Communications, Product Marketing and Compliance to make sure information about TransferGo is accurate, consistent and trustworthy. This space is evolving quickly, so you will test new approaches, measure their impact and turn what works into repeatable practice. **Website growth** Own the commercial performance and growth roadmap of TransferGo's marketing website. You will improve customer journeys, landing pages and conversion paths across priority countries and customer segments. Using customer insight, analytics and experimentation, you will identify and remove conversion barriers and build scalable landing-page and content frameworks that support acquisition campaigns, product launches and expansion into new countries. You will partner with Product, Design, Engineering and Compliance to deliver improvements while keeping website content accurate, compliant, localised and consistent with the TransferGo brand. You will balance long-term platform development against the need to launch, learn and improve quickly. **Measurement and influence** Define how we measure organic visibility, AI visibility, qualified traffic, conversion and commercial impact. You will build reporting that connects search, AI visibility and website performance to business outcomes rather than activity metrics. You will own the relevant analytics, SEO and AI-monitoring tools and manage agencies, freelancers and technology partners where needed. You will turn data into clear priorities and investment cases, and help teams across the business understand how customer discovery is changing. **What success looks like** * Sustainable growth in qualified organic traffic and, more importantly, in the number of new customers acquired through it. * Stronger organic visibility across our priority countries and the send-and-receive routes that matter commercially. * A stronger and more accurate presence across AI-powered search and answer platforms, measured rather than assumed. * Higher website conversion and a clear, measurable contribution to customer acquisition. * A healthy technical foundation, with fewer critical issues and faster resolution when they arise. * Faster delivery of effective landing pages and localised content, using scalable frameworks rather than starting from scratch each time. * Reporting that leadership trusts and uses to make investment decisions. You'll report to our Director of BRand Marketing & Demand. **Here's what we'd love from our new Organic Growth Lead:** * Strong experience in SEO, organic growth or web-led customer acquisition, with commercial results you can demonstrate. * Deep technical SEO knowledge, including crawling, indexing, JavaScript rendering, site architecture, structured data and Core Web Vitals. * Experience leading international and multilingual SEO across several countries. * A strong understanding of content strategy, keyword and intent research, internal linking and authority building. * Practical knowledge of AEO and GEO, including how AI-powered platforms discover, assess and cite information. * Experience owning or significantly influencing a commercial website and its roadmap, including conversion optimisation and experimentation. * Strong analytical skills, and a track record of connecting search and website performance to acquisition, revenue or another business outcome. * Experience working effectively with developers, designers, analysts, writers, product teams and commercial stakeholders. * The confidence to prioritise competing demands and turn strategy into delivery. **And if you can also do this stuff, even better:** * Hands-on experience measuring brand visibility across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or similar platforms. * Experience in fintech, financial services, marketplaces or international consumer products. * Experience working with Compliance in a regulated environment. **About you** You combine deep organic search expertise with commercial thinking and a willingness to get hands-on. You are curious about how customer discovery is changing and you understand that search now extends well beyond traditional rankings. You move comfortably between technical SEO, content, AI visibility, website experience and commercial performance. You are structured enough to build a long-term roadmap, pragmatic enough to act when an opportunity appears, and influential enough to bring several teams around a shared growth goal. ### **What we believe** **At TransferGo**, we offer competitive rewards to all people. We know that recognition is about more than just money, and we've fostered a culture of kudos to shine a light on the great work throughout the business, and the people making it all happen. We hold regular in person events to connect with each other and help all our TransferNauts to grow with a generous training allowance. We believe that empowering people makes for a happier and more effective workforce. This means we enable anyone who wants to pursue initiatives that deliver real value for our migrant customers. **What We Offer:** * **Competitive Salary**: Starting from 14,900 PLN-22,390 PLN (gross) per month, depending on experience. title: Technical Writer - PostgreSQL (Remote)
description: We are looking for a talented and flexible Technical Writer to join one of our distributed open-source software development teams. You will work on the PostgreSQL database and related components, in close collaboration with our dedicated PostgreSQL team. Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL brings together essential enterprise components from the broader PostgreSQL open-source community into a single, integrated distribution designed and tested to ensure compatibility. You will represent our voice to our technical customers and provide complete, clear documentation for our PostgresSQL products. We seek someone committed to delivering consistent, high-quality, and on-time documentation, whether in the form of guides, user manuals, help files, or man pages. You should be comfortable working in version-controlled environments, as we adopt a docs-as-code methodology. You will be embedded in the PostgreSQL team, but also working alongside the Product Documentation team, which comprises several technical writers dedicated to developing a scalable documentation strategy that drives user adoption and effective use of our products. You are expected to collaborate with the other writers as we aim to continuously improve our practices. **Location/time zone** Remote work from home. Open to worldwide candidates, but the team median is UTC-2, so we recommend candidates operate within +/- 4 hours of this baseline. **What you will do** * Create all technical documentation from install/configuration/troubleshooting guides, how-tos, user manuals, man pages, to -help prompts * Participate in team ceremonies. Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Devs, and QA to output high-quality documentation * Use text, markdown, images, and diagrams to ensure that audiences of all experience levels can extract value from our documentation * Leverage AI tooling to quickly draft, polish, format, and refine content * Maintain documentation versioning and be a contributor to our overall documentation strategy **Your experience** * Graduate-level written English and excellent verbal communication skills * Experience with documenting complex systems and writing user-oriented documentation * 3+ years of experience as a technical writer and ability to write high-quality and precise documentation * Experience with markup languages (Markdown preferred) * Experience with the installation and configuration of database server software on Linux * Docs-as-code experience. Knowledge of Jenkins, git, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript (strongly recommended) * Experience in leveraging AI tooling for documentation purposes * Comfortable with Linux command line * Distributed system development and/or database server development * Fluent in developer tools like git, gcc, gdb * Working autonomously in a globally distributed organization * Collaborating with open source communities and colleagues via mailing lists, Slack, etc. * Using collaboration/tracking tools like Jira/Notion * Proven success working in a distributed environment * Quick learner and great team player **What will (really) make you stand out** * A developer or DevOps background * Having a track record of contributing to PostgreSQL or other open source projects. Being an active member of the PostgreSQL community * A solid understanding of PostgreSQL internals to write accurate content to potentially contribute upstream * A solid working knowledge of advanced concepts such as database storage engines, at-rest encryption, and cloud orchestration * Ability to build and maintain automated documentation testing, CI/CD pipelines for documentation process, and validation tools * Experienced conference speaker, technical blog writer, active on public forums or mailing lists **Communication, travel, and remote collaboration** Percona is a globally distributed, remote-first organization that values active communication and collaboration. While working from your home office, it's important to engage openly and proactively with your team. We promote lively discussions, idea sharing, and transparent work updates. To foster a strong team environment, we depend on consistent communication via tools like Slack, Zoom, and Jira, which keep us connected, aligned, and supportive across different time zones. Although travel isn't always necessary, there may occasionally be opportunities for conferences or in-person meetups to strengthen relationships and ensure strategic alignment. **Working environment, planning, and growth** At Percona, we prioritize a structured work environment to support your focus and flow. We organize our tasks within specific timeframes and scopes, minimizing shifting priorities to allow you to concentrate on assigned tasks. This planning process is collaborative, involving the entire team, Product, and customer insights. Professional growth is a focus for us, as we designate Fridays as no-meeting days. This provides us dedicated time for deep work, tackling challenging issues, or exploring new technologies. **Typical day as a technical writer in the PostgreSQL team at Percona** * **Morning (flexible, as you own your schedule):** Start your day by checking Slack, email, and Jira for updates. title: LV Scoping & Licensing Specialist
description: Job Purpose: ***Job Purpose*** The purpose of the Scoping & Licensing Specialist role is to support the accurate scoping, quoting and licensing of client projects, ensuring requirements are clearly understood and projects are set up for successful delivery. The role works closely with clients and internal teams to provide accurate information, support efficient project planning and contribute to a high-quality client experience. **About Transform** At RWS, we enable the world’s largest enterprises to communicate with global audiences through cutting-edge language technology, AI-driven solutions, and expert services. Our RWS Transform division empowers organizations to accelerate digital transformation, scale global content, and unlock growth in every market. Job Overview: **Key Responsibilities** * Communicate with clients to gather project requirements and ensure accurate and timely quotations. * Review **clinical trial protocols and client request forms** to identify relevant information relating to instrument usage and project requirements. * Prepare **licensing quotation modules** and support clients with changes to project scope, requirements and priorities. * Maintain clear and accurate records of **scope changes and project updates**. * Research previous translation projects and questionnaires to identify existing work, avoid duplication and determine applicable archive discounts. * Prepare basic and intermediate **Linguistic Validation (LV) quotations**, including word counts, formatting requirements and estimated resource needs. * Process basic and intermediate Linguistic Validation projects according to client requirements and established procedures. * Coordinate with internal teams to ensure estimates are accurate, achievable and aligned with available resources. * Assign standard and urgent projects to appropriate qualified translators and debriefers based on language, expertise, availability and deadlines. * Ensure translators and other resources receive clear and accurate project instructions. * Coordinate with Finance to support accurate **invoicing and payment processing**. * Support and improve **licensing and repository processes** based on client feedback. * Identify and escalate resource, quality or delivery issues when required. * Contribute to process improvements and maintain consistency and quality across deliverables. * Support the onboarding and mentoring of junior team members when required. **Skills & Experience** * Bachelor’s degree with approximately **1–2 years of relevant professional experience** preferred. * Previous experience in **COA licensing and/or Linguistic Validation** is highly desirable. * Experience with **medical terminology, clinical research or related healthcare environments** is desirable. * Strong research and analytical skills, with the ability to **find, interpret, summarise and compile information** from different sources. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating with clients and internal stakeholders. * Strong **planning, organisation and attention to detail**, particularly when managing multiple requests and deadlines. * Comfortable working in a **structured, deadline-driven environment** and managing competing priorities. * Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Ability to understand project requirements and select appropriate resources based on **language, expertise, availability and quality requirements**. * Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office and other business systems**, with the ability to learn new tools. * Understanding of quality requirements and the ability to work within established **QMS processes and standards**, including ISO 9001 and ISO 17100. * Ability to handle confidential information appropriately and maintain accurate documentation. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. title: Marketing Automation Project Specialist
description: **Job Title** Marketing Automation Project Specialist **Location** Europe / Remote **About Us** Ingersoll Rand is a global industrial technology leader, delivering mission-critical products, services and digital experiences for customers across Europe and the wider EMEIA region. Within ITS CSS EMEIA, our Demand Generation & Digital Experience team drives how our brands are discovered, understood and chosen online — combining strong content, modern web technology and data-driven marketing to fuel commercial growth. **Job Summary** We are looking for a **Marketing Automation Project Specialist** to help us design and deliver advanced customer-journey and automation projects across multiple brands and markets. Reporting directly to the **Marketing Orchestration & Automation Enablement Manager**, you will support the development and implementation of **strategic marketing automation concepts** and translate them into scalable, technology-enabled programs that improve personalization, automation efficiency, and campaign performance. You will be working within an international team, you will shape how our company uses marketing automation and AI to engage customers more intelligently. This role is ideal for a mid-level professional who enjoys turning ambiguous business needs into structured, scalable solutions. You will bring new capabilities and channels from idea to usable state: building the concept, the business case and the requirements, and then working with our product and technical development teams who build them. Technology fluency matters – hands-on development does not. **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead complex capability projects end to end** – from business case and concept design through requirements, pilot, validation and rollout – making sure every solution is designed to scale across brands and markets rather than to solve a single need. * **Own the concept and the requirements, not the build.** Define the business logic, functional and technical requirements, and success criteria, and hand them over to the product and development teams who deliver the technical implementation. * **Evaluate and pilot new capabilities and channels**, assessing business value, feasibility, effort and readiness before anything is scaled, for example: + AI-driven use cases (predictive engagement, automated segmentation, content generation and optimization) + New engagement channels (SMS, WhatsApp and other conversational or emerging channels) + Dynamic content and personalization capabilities + Process and workflow automation (modular email components, automated campaign creation) + Integrations that connect the marketing automation platform with CRM, web, data and content ecosystems * **Define integration and vendor requirements** towards product, IT and external partners, including data flows, event tracking, preference handling and platform dependencies. * **Frame consent, compliance and technical feasibility early**, working with legal, data privacy and platform teams so new capabilities are compliant and viable by design (GDPR, ePrivacy, consent and preference management). * **Run initiatives in an agile delivery model** – translating concepts into epics and user stories, sequencing work across sprints, and managing dependencies and blockers together with product owners and delivery leads. * **Prove value before scaling** – design pilots with clear KPIs, validate results with the measurement and analytics teams, and recommend whether a capability should scale, evolve or stop. * **Hand over to business as usual** – once a capability becomes standard, document it, train and enable subject matter experts and business teams, and transfer ownership so the capability runs without you. * **Stay ahead of the market** on marketing automation, AI applications, channel innovation and data-privacy standards, and turn relevant trends into concrete, business-justified proposals. **How This Role Works** This is a solution design and project leadership role, not a hands-on development role. You are expected to understand technology well enough to shape it, challenge it and assess feasibility – but platform development, integrations and code are delivered by a dedicated technical and product team. Your success is measured by the capabilities you define, deliver, validate and successfully hand over, not by what you build yourself. **Qualifications** **Required** * 4+ years of experience in marketing automation, MarTech, CRM or customer-journey management, ideally in an international B2B environment. * Working knowledge of **Oracle Eloqua** or another enterprise marketing automation platform – enough to design solutions, scope requirements and judge feasibility. Deep technical development experience is **not** required. * Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional projects from concept through to adoption. * Strong business analysis skills: ability to translate business objectives into clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria that technical teams can build from. * Solid understanding of customer-data management, segmentation and personalization concepts. * Comfortable working with technical teams and vendors on integrations, data flows and APIs at a conceptual and requirements level. * Awareness of data privacy and consent requirements (GDPR, ePrivacy) and how they shape solution design. * Strong analytical mindset and **critical thinking** skills, with the confidence to challenge requests and reframe the underlying problem. * Excellent communication in English (spoken and written). * Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional, international, and matrixed environments. **Preferred** * Experience working with **agile project management methodologies** like Scrum, including backlog management and sprint-based delivery; hands-on use of Jira or a similar tool and any agile certification is a plus. * Experience piloting new channels (SMS, WhatsApp, conversational messaging) or AI/ML use cases in a marketing context. * Experience building business cases and supporting vendor evaluation or selection. * Familiarity with CRM, CMS/DAM, data and analytics tools (e.g. Salesforce, Snowflake, Qlik, Power BI). * Conceptual understanding of integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, event tracking) and workflow automation tools. * Awareness of AI/ML applications in marketing (predictive models, generative content, intelligent routing). * Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Marketing, Communications, Business or related field. **Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements** Remote or hybrid working arrangement within Europe, with occasional travel of up to 20%. **Key Competencies** * **Project & Delivery Leadership** – plans, sequences and delivers several complex initiatives in parallel, comfortable working in agile cadences. * **Requirements Definition & Solution Design** – turns ambiguous business needs into structured, buildable requirements that technical teams can execute without rework. * **Critical Thinking & Problem Solving** – identifies root causes, evaluates options and applies logic to complex, cross-functional situations. * **Scalability & Governance Mindset** – designs reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions, and thinks ahead about adoption, maintenance and compliance. * **Business Understanding** – frames every initiative in terms of business value, effort and measurable impact. * **Stakeholder Management & Influence** – aligns business units, technical teams and vendors without relying on formal authority. * **Ownership & Clean Handover** – sees initiatives through option and transfers them properly to the teams that will run them. * Curiosity, innovation mindset, and continuous learning. * Attention to detail, structure, and process orientation. **What we Offer (Poland)** * Competitive base salary, ensuring fair compensation for your skills and experience. * Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication. * We are all owners of the company! Stock options that align your interests with the company's success. * Private Medical Care, ensuring your well-being is taken care of. * Cafeteria / Holiday subsidy to support your leisure time and work-life balance. * Hybrid work model, providing flexibility and work-life balance. * Stable working environment, focusing on long-term cooperation and mutual growth. * Opportunities for professional growth and development, including Technical, Professional, and Skills Training in all required tools & individual development plan with internal Mentorship program. * Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork. **Salary Range for Poland** 7,550-12,400 PLN Please note our benefits package is location-dependent - we’ll walk you through the specifics of other countries as we move forward in the process.

title: Senior Specialist - AI & Excellence M/F
description: Vacancy description Senior Specialist - AI & Excellence M/F At KK Group, our People, Branding & Sustainability (PBS) function is strengthening its focus on Artificial Intelligence, automation, and future-ready capabilities. Leveraging AI and automation to optimize workflows and increase efficiency. Identifying, developing, and scaling AI use cases that deliver tangible business value. Helping colleagues translate AI opportunities into practical solutions. Leading process design and transformation initiatives that simplify, automate, and digitalize ways of working. Preparing key PBS processes for HRIS implementation and future system migrations. Identifying re-platforming opportunities and supporting future-of-work initiatives. Governing AI agents and automation solutions across PBS. Driving process excellence within global improvement and transformation projects. Elevating existing KKMS processes into automated, scalable workflows. Tracking adoption, impact metrics, KPIs, and ROI related to AI, automation, and process improvements. Supporting and potentially playing a key role in the KK Group AI Academy . Strong experience with process optimization, automation, and transformation initiatives. Hands-on experience driving AI adoption and capability building within organizations. Experience working with tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, ChatGPT, Claude, AI agents, GPTs, and automation platforms. Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced prompt engineering. Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills. Experience facilitating workshops, coaching colleagues, and driving behavioral change. A strong passion for AI, innovation, continuous learning, and future workplace trends. A challenger mindset with the ability to question the status quo and inspire new ways of thinking. Experience within People & Culture / HR processes would be considered an advantage. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other process excellence methodologies is a plus. How You Will Add Value This role is more than a technology position. It is about building capabilities that will help PBS and ultimately KK Group scale, innovate, and support future growth. **Your success will be measured through your ability to:** Automate manual processes and achieve 20-30% reductions in cycle time and cost-to-serve across core PBS services. Prepare processes for successful HRIS implementation and future platform transitions. Increase AI adoption and engagement across the PBS AI community. Enable organizational growth without proportional increases in headcount. Redesign and simplify core PBS processes together with process owners. Drive greater standardization, automation, and scalability across PBS operations. We offer By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact. Potential Benefits (Depending on Role) Further information If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis. **For further information, please contact:** Julia Poniewiera +48 539 050 035 About KK Group KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries. With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets. The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence. Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow. pierwszego praktycznego doświadczenia w SEO – agencyjnego, in-house lub zdobytego przy własnych projektach, * umiejętności przeprowadzenia keyword researchu i podstawowej analizy konkurencji, * It provides valuable, engaging and memorable experiences for military service members and their families, and may also guide and administer volunteers. **Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential Duties)** * Execute day-to-day Center operational procedures, ensuring a cost-effective, safe, welcoming and clean environment. Working knowledge of various software, applications, and programs including but not limited to Microsoft Office Suite. title: FAR Senior Specialist

Founded 150 years ago, Zurich is transforming insurance. In addition to providing insurance protection, Zurich is increasingly offering prevention services such as those that promote wellbeing and enhance climate resilience. Reflecting its purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ Zurich aspires to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. title: Junior Customer Service Specialist with English

Teams at Toyota Motor Europe and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Poland in Lower Silesia are all working togther to deliver the best mobility solutions for users around the world. **Our Digital Hub is Toyota Motor Europe’s IT** research and development centre, established in 2026 in Wrocław. We are responsible for developing and maintaining software and connected digital services for the Toyota and Lexus brands in Europe. Become part of our team and help us shape the future. Joining this team means contributing to resilient cloud security capabilities, helping manage cyber risk in modern enterprise environments, and playing a visible role in enabling secure innovation across digital platforms and services. We work at the intersection of technology, risk, and business enablement, creating practical security outcomes that support Toyota’s long-term ambitions. **Role Summary:** We are looking for a **Cloud Security Advisor** who is passionate about helping shape and strengthen secure cloud adoption across a complex enterprise environment. In this role, you will work closely with infrastructure, platform, DevOps, and compliance teams to embed security by design, reduce risk in a pragmatic way, and support secure operations at scale. practical mitigation strategies * Support teams in identifying, prioritising, and remediating cloud security weaknesses effectively * Act as a trusted partner for infrastructure, platform, and project teams, helping embed secure-by-design thinking into delivery * Translate complex technical risks into clear, actionable guidance for both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Contribute to cloud security monitoring, incident response preparedness, and investigation support where needed * Help strengthen DevSecOps practices by integrating security controls into automation and CI/CD pipelines * secure cloud adoption, architecture, or operational security across enterprise platforms We welcome candidates from non-traditional career paths and those with transferable skills or equivalent practical experience. inclusive in your style and you take a customer-oriented approach **What we can offer you:** * Depending on the candidate’s skills and experience, the base salary for this position will be in the invite you to a recruitment interview. The Service Owner balances platform reliability, developer experience, risk reduction, and cost efficiency while partnering closely with Engineering, Security, and Operations teams. **Key Responsibilities:** **Service Ownership & Strategy** * Own the end-to-end DevSecOps service lifecycle (design, build, run, improve). * Define and maintain the DevSecOps service roadmap aligned with business and security priorities. * Establish service standards, guardrails, and reference architectures. * Ensure the platform scales to support organizational growth and cloud adoption. **Secure SDLC Enablement** * Embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows. * Drive adoption of secure coding, SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and container security. * Define and enforce security gates and quality thresholds. * Partner with AppSec and Security teams on risk management and remediation workflows. **Platform Reliability & Operations** * Ensure high availability, performance, and resilience of DevSecOps tooling and pipelines. * Define SLAs/SLOs and monitor service health. * Lead incident management and root cause analysis for platform issues. * Manage upgrades, capacity planning, and technical debt. **Governance, Risk & Compliance** * Ensure DevSecOps processes meet internal security policies and external regulatory requirements. * Support audit readiness (e.g., SOX, ISO, SOC2 as applicable). * Implement access controls, audit logging, and segregation of duties. * Maintain risk register and drive remediation plans. **Automation & Continuous deployment frequency, and failure rates. * Promote shift-left and shift-right security practices. **Stakeholder & Service Management** * Act as the primary service owner and escalation point. * Manage Together with our customers and partners, we are accelerating the green transition and working towards a world that lasts forever. As an IT Service Desk Specialist, you will: * Provide first-line support to users with hardware, software, access rights, networks and other IT-related services. * Resolve issues affecting individual users as well as contribute to resolving incidents with a wider impact on business and production operations. * Work closely with local and global IT teams to identify root causes and continuously improve our IT services. The role is performed during regular office hours. ### **What you will do** * Act as the first point of contact for users seeking technical support via chat, service portal, phone or email. * Investigate and resolve IT issues remotely, gathering the required information for further investigation when needed. * Advise and guide users in the use of IT services and digital tools. * Escalate unresolved issues, or those requiring deeper expertise, to the appropriate support teams. * Document investigations, actions and resolutions in our IT service management system. * Share user feedback and improvement ideas with internal teams to support continuous service development. * Contribute to maintaining the IT knowledge base and identify opportunities to improve ways of working and processes. ### **What we expect from you** You will succeed in this role if you are a service-minded problem solver who can remain calm, even in busy or urgent situations. **Curiosity and a genuine willingness to investigate, learn and explore new things are critical to success in this role.** Not every issue comes with a ready-made answer, which is why we value someone who wants to understand what is causing the problem and find the right solution together with others. **About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75\+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning\-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**
The Communications team makes sure every message counts. They turn complex ideas into clear, compelling stories that resonate across the business and beyond. By shaping how Revolut speaks to the world, they connect teams, amplify our brand, and ensure the right message reaches the right audience at the right time.


We’re looking for a Localisation Specialist (Translator) to help us bring Revolut to Basque\-speaking customers. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our content isn't just translated, but truly localised and culturally relevant to the market.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

**What you'll be doing*** Copying HTML content
* Delivering high\-quality copy adapted in your target language (transcreation) for all types of content produced (app, website, emails, etc.)
* Ensuring daily volume expectations are met
* Adapting long\-term strategic brand, tone, and vision to local markets, cultural differences, and perceptions
* Suggesting long\-term strategic content projects
* Contributing to live translation updates, maintaining the brand's tone of voice and strategic messaging that aligns to wider company goals

**What you'll need*** Fluency in Basque (C2/native level)
* Fluency in English (C1\+ level)
* 2\+ years of experience as a copywriter
* A bachelor's degree in literature, journalism, marketing, or relevant field
* Outstanding writing skills
* Experience with proofreading
* Knowledge of the fintech industry
* Great time management skills
* The ability to multitask
* Solid interpersonal and communication skills
* To be a critical thinker with a problem\-solving personality

**Compensation range*** Poland: PLN8,200 \- PLN9,100 gross monthly\*
* Lithuania: €2,000 \- €2,200 gross monthly\*
* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process
* Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience
